priorRecord.cause: the committed record was STALE, not the hub. Re-running at that commit's own graph_usages.ts reproduces 34/40 exactly (measured), and all six failures are the caller SET being 5 groups instead of 2: src/lsp/graph_usages.ts was admitting `Greeter contains render` as a caller of render. Commit 84fccdd23 fixed that at the owner by filtering declaration containments with the vocabulary owner's own predicate, and re-running at HEAD with only that file reverted gives the six failures back. So the defect was real, it was upstream of this gate, and it was fixed by another lane's merge — this gate never had a hub-surface defect. The record sat red because it was not re-emitted.
priorRecord.lawThatGoverns: §14 rule 1 (one surface, one answer) with §13.1: a declaration containment is how a symbol is DECLARED, never who uses it (src/lsp/relations.ts, isDeclarationRelationship).
